title: Ultimate Foundation of Economic Science
author: Ludwig von Mises
description: Dive into the profound insights of Ludwig von Mises in his final masterpiece, where he distills a lifetime of economic thought as a leading figure of the Austrian School. This book not only captures the remarkable triumph of economic freedom in fostering prosperity but also highlights the critical mistakes that civilizations often make, which stifle both their wealth and liberty. Mises argues that socialism is destined to fail because it cannot adequately address the complexities of economic calculation. Without totalitarian oversight, human behavior remains unpredictable and cannot be analyzed like the immutable laws of nature. Yet, within this unpredictability lies a consistent pattern when individuals are free to pursue their own desires, they engage in creative problem-solving that fuels economic growth. Join Michele Fry as she summarizes this essential work that speaks to the heart of economic theory and human potential.

author: John Ruskin
description: Sesame and Lilies delves into the profound questions of how, what, and why we read, exploring their relevance to how we live our lives. He believes these lectures encapsulate the core truths he has aimed to communicate throughout his career. This revised edition features two prefaces and three insightful lectures, including “Of Kings’ Treasuries” and “Of Queens Gardens.” Originally delivered in December 1864, these lectures highlight the transformative power of literature and the influence of remarkable women. The third lecture, Of the Mystery of Life and Its Arts, was added in 1871, enriching the discussion on the beauty of reading and honor. Join us as we uncover the essence of good books and the wisdom they offer.

His expedition was fraught with peril, from language barriers and cultural differences to imprisonment and robbery. Armed only with tattered clothes, a horse, a pocket compass, and a hat for his notes, he followed the Gambia River before becoming the first European to reach the mighty Niger River at Ségou. Continuing another 80 miles to Silla, he faced the harsh reality of limited supplies, forcing him to turn back. Parks incredible adventure is a testament to human resilience and curiosity, ultimately leading him home by boat via America. (Summary by Lynda Marie Neilson)

Although the ambitious second volume, intended to delve into foreign trade, money, trade fluctuations, taxation, and collectivism, was never released, the impact of this text continues to resonate today. title: Complete Works of Brann, The Iconoclast, Volume 12
author: William Cowper Brann
description: William Cowper Brann, aptly nicknamed The Iconoclast, boldly challenged the status quo, targeting institutions and beliefs he deemed arrogant and self-serving. Settling in the rugged town of Waco, Texas, during the late 1800s, Brann made his mark as a newspaper man—first as a writer and later as the owner of The Iconoclast newspaper. This tumultuous period saw fierce battles between Catholics and Protestants over Texass soul, with further sectarian conflicts among Protestants. Branns prolific writing style and unapologetic opinions made waves, as he fiercely criticized Baptists, Prohibition, and universities with the ferocity of a gunfight—an irony not lost on history, as he met his own demise in a shootout at the age of 43. After being shot in the back, he managed to draw his weapon and kill his assailant, before walking himself to jail, where he ultimately died the next morning. Volume 12 features a collection of his thought-provoking newspaper editorials, reflections on his untimely death, and a mix of both praise and critique of his brash, junk-yard-dog approach to journalism. Prepare for a captivating listening experience filled with his sharp insights and unforgettable rhetoric!

Lagerlöfs journey in crafting The Story of Gösta Berling is beautifully recounted in her literary autobiography, The Story of a Story, also featured in this volume. The novella centers on a girl who has strayed from the right path, yet her inherent honesty and goodness ultimately lead her to redemption through the love of a noble man and the admiration of her community. This poignant tale is part of a collection that includes nine other captivating short stories, with special thanks to the publishers of Good Housekeeping for allowing the inclusion of The Legend of the Christmas Rose. This translated edition is published with the authors full approval.

title: Edge AI Beyond TOPS: How Connectivity Design Determines Deployment Success
author: ATTEND Technology Podcast
description: As Edge AI systems move from the lab into factories, outdoor equipment, and mobile platforms, computing performance is not the only factor that determines reliability. From camera links, FAKRA, and Automotive Ethernet to M.2, CAMM2, board-to-board connectors, and IP67, IP68, and IP69K protection, this episode examines how connectors and cable assemblies affect signal integrity, environmental resilience, serviceability, and long-term deployment reliability. It also highlights the key requirements engineering teams should define early in the component selection process.

title: Jamin's Podcast
author: Jamin Brazil
description:
Twenty-minute conversations with founders and operators about what actually happened. Scaling, systems, career. One guest, one confession, one thing you can use Monday morning.

Hosted by Jamin Brazil, 3x founder with 4 exits, who's sat in the founder seat, the CEO seat, and the COO seat, and knows which questions get an honest answer instead of a rehearsed one.

title: Tech Wins The Day
author: Sherloc Research
description:
Tech Wins The Day is your daily briefing on the stories moving the AI and tech world... model releases, major company moves, funding rounds, research breakthroughs, and the policy fights shaping where this industry goes next. 


Every episode is a quick, no-fluff rundown of what actually mattered in the last 24 hours, delivered fast so you can stay ahead without digging through headlines yourself.

title: Behind The Laundry Door
author: Indy Clinton
description:
Everyone’s got dirty laundry, but not everyone airs it.
We’re just two tired parents wanting to have an uninterrupted, honest conversation. We dive into the type of topics every parent thinks, but nobody says out loud. The convos you try have with a friend at the park, but your kids keep interrupting. We’re not perfect parents and we don’t have it all figured out... But hey, that’s parenthood! We’re going down shit creek together.  
The door is closed, the filter is off, the mics are on, and the kids are out. Consider this couples therapy, or perhaps a date. Or maybe even foreplay. We will take anything at this point.

title: Lost In Hip-Hop
author: DJ Concept, DJ Mickey Knox & Mr. Menza
description: DJ Concept and DJ Mickey Knox return after a successful nationwide mixshow run with a new evolution: Lost In Hip-Hop. Adding in co-host Mr. Menza, this show is a full-on celebration of Hip-Hop in all its forms. Each week you can expect appearances from respected guests, offering deep-dive interviews and rare insights into the culture and minds of Hip-Hop’s elite. Going live on Twitch every week, they go on a journey led by instinct and inspiration. From classic throwback sets to brand new releases and everything in between, Lost In Hip-Hop delivers a diverse, carefully curated mix.

title: The Data Said What It Said
author: Julexus & Sekani
description: The Data Said What It Said is a spicy, side‑eye‑friendly education podcast where two instructional coaches pull apart education research, drag bad data gently, and ask what actually works for real kids in real classrooms. Receipts, context, and a little chaos, every episode.

title: The Curious Christians
author: Cody Pennington
description: Exploring God’s Word, and asking and answering questions that plague believers.

title: Uncanny Canon
author: Monk Mangham Parker
description: Examining the Weird in fiction, history, myth & poetry

title: Come Along with the Motls
author: Come Along w/ The Motls
description: Welcome to Come Along with the Motls! We're Ryan and Ivy, and we're inviting you into our family's journey of following Jesus, embracing adventure, and finding joy in the everyday. Through honest conversations, real stories, and the lessons God is teaching us, our hope is to encourage your family to see the beauty, purpose, and presence of God in every moment of life. We're so glad you're here. Come along.

title: In the Loop with Holly & Angi
author: Angi Milano & Holly Glowaty
description:
In the Loop with Angi Milano and Holly Glowaty. The GTM Loop podcast is where founders, operators, and industry leaders get real about building go-to-market strategies that actually work. Each episode breaks down the moves that drive growth, from selling to banks without losing your mind to turning compliance into a sales advantage. 
Expect candid conversations, practical tactics, and stories from the trenches that help you sell it, keep it, and grow it.

title: Acadiana Sports Network
author: Chris Logan
description: Join Ragin' Cajuns basketball great, Eric Mouton and Charlie Jaubert every week for the Acadiana Sports Network Podcast. The guys will cover all high school sports and bring you some great stories from the amazing you athletes from the area.

title: Just Chris' Podcast
author: Christopher Venegas
description: Welcome to the podcast where nothing is off-limits. From mental health and relationships to embarrassing stories, random life updates, and the occasional chaotic moment, we’re keeping it honest, relatable, and (hopefully) making you laugh along the way. If you like real conversations with a little humor, you’re in the right place.

title: Philosophy Talks
author: Kimon, Cedric and Jean
description: It all started with innocent philosophical questions, but no question is truly innocent. After many enlightening philosophical discussions, a year has passed and we have reached the perfect moment to invite others to think about the beautiful world of philosophy. Escape everyday life and play with your thoughts: be enthralled, disagree, get angry, get involved! This is Philosophy Talks. Thanks for listening.

title: The AI Ethics & Governance Desk by Hema Lakkaraju
author: HemaL
description: Who's really accountable when AI gets it wrong? The AI Ethics & Governance Desk, hosted by Hema Lakkaraju, breaks down the policies, standards, and real-world dilemmas defining responsible AI.

title: Bus Stations
author: Bus Station
description:
Welcome to the bus station podcast,
where everyday life, events, and stories take place. Bus Station podcasts provide you with information like travel tips, passenger experiences, stories from drivers, employees, and much more. This podcast breaks you out of the monotonous routine and brings you to the heart of bus station life and everything that makes it tick. It explores the people who keep it going up and running and the happenings that unfold within this unique space.

Each episode dives into various topics, including events, transportation news, bus travel safety, experiences, and much more.
You will learn about this unique environment through the eyes of its visitors, drivers, and workers. Every aspect of bus stantion is discussed, from the short trips to the most extreme travels and the communities found at these stations. The podcast is perfect for travelers, commuters, and curious minds interested in learning about this transport wonderland. So hop on board and begin uncovering all the amazing tales and stories that await at every corner!

title: The DC Beer Show
author: DC Beer
description: The official podcast of DCBeer ! Everything you need to know about the people, places, and brews that make the DMV America’s best beer scene, including the best local places for eats, brews, trivia, live music, and more! Learn about the latest trends in craft beer – from the beers, to the breweries, to the business – from the gang at DC Beer.

title: Grace To Go with the Route 66 Chaplain
author: Christopher Tuttle
description:
Grace To Go is a weekly Sunday series from Christopher Tuttle, the Route 66 Chaplain. Every episode starts with something real, a moment on the road, at a rest stop, behind the wheel somewhere between exits, and lets a short scripture reframe it into something you can actually carry into your week.
This isn't a sermon and it isn't church. You don't need a pew or a church background to feel what's here, just a few minutes and a cup of coffee. Grace To Go is part of the Faith and Good Courage family, alongside Roadside Notes and Healing Highway, all rooted in Route 66 and the sacred moments hiding in ordinary life.
New episodes every Sunday morning. Coffee's always on.

title: Christian Poetry, Prayers, Reminders, Reflections, and Life Lessons
author: Erica Felisa Thompson
description: Erica Felisa Thompson is sharing Christian Poetry, Prayers, Reminders, Reflections, and Life Lessons in light of real life situations on your walk with God. Most of the episodes are from her series Spirit Man which can be found on Amazon. Thanks in advance for your support and I pray that God pours back into you a hundred fold!!! Love y’all with the love of God!!!!

title: The Green Grimoire Podcast
author: Damh and Cerri
description: A monthly podcast that explores the Book of Nature - The Green Grimiore - from a Pagan/Animist point of view. Join Damh the Cerri as they discuss topics drawn from the magical ’Jar of Inspiration’.

author: Raglan Community Media
description:
Umberto and Jax share keys to a great marriage.Interviews from the Faith Matters show, including 
Becoming Unoffendable with Denise J Gardener
Mariage Matters with Jax and Umberto Benucci
Pastor's Corner with Roger Peart
Plus stories to inspire and encourage as we journey through this thing called life.

Taken from the Faith Matters show broadcast on Raglan Community Radio on Fridays at midday.

title: Aging Gracefully with Julie
author: WIHS Network
description: Aging Gracefully with Julie is a podcast that was created by a registered nurse and certified senior advisor, Julie Cruz. The podcast was created for adults, typically in their 40s to 50s, who are simultaneously managing the care, financial support, and daily needs of their children and aging parents. It is also for seniors 65+. The podcast delivers information in a holistic manner by diving into the mental, emotional, physical and spiritual being of the listener. All while providing education, guidance and resources for families caring for elderly loved ones as well as for seniors.

title: Dad, Interrupted
author: Dad, Interrupted
description:
This podcast is here to help dads navigate the messy intersection of fatherhood, mental health, personal identity, and relationships - one interruption at a time.
Visit our Linktree: linktr.ee/dadinterruptedpod

title: Beyond the Desert- A Tale of Death Valley
author: Alfred Noyes
description: Immerse yourself in a gripping short novel that weaves together adventure, philosophy, and the complexities of world politics. Follow the journey of an accused criminal who escapes into the vast, unforgiving expanse of Death Valley, California. There, he faces the harsh realities of nature and encounters a fascinating array of eccentric desert dwellers. With poetic prose that vividly paints the landscape and a passionate undercurrent of political activism, this work showcases the talents of an English author renowned as a poet, best known for The Highwayman. While primarily a poet, he also crafted thought-provoking prose infused with an anti-war sentiment. (This preview may be edited later.) - Summary by Douglas Wood

title: Amelia (Vol. 1)
author: Henry Fielding
description: In the captivating first volume of a three-part series, Amelia defies her mothers wishes by marrying William Booth, leading them to a new life in London. As they navigate the complexities of married life, Fielding deftly examines themes of infidelity and the contentious debate over womens intelligence compared to mens. Join Amelia on her journey of love, struggle, and self-discovery. (Summary by Libby Gohn)

title: Sonday Sessions
author: Nate and Josiah Galvante
description: Sonday Sessions is a podcast where two brothers in ministry have honest conversations about following Jesus and pursuing a life of holiness in a world full of distractions, shifting culture, and competing ideas.

title: Noticiero Buenos Días Quincy WA
author: The Fallible Man LLC
description:
Descargo de responsabilidad: Este programa ha sido traducido del inglés al español mediante inteligencia artificial.


Buenos Días Quincy WA


Tu fuente diaria de noticias locales.


Buenos Días Quincy WA es un pódcast matutino de lunes a viernes dedicado a mantener informado, conectado y con una sonrisa al corazón de la Cuenca del Columbia. Cubriendo Quincy, Winchester, George y Crescent Bar, este programa se enfoca en las personas, los lugares y las historias que hacen que nuestra comunidad se sienta como un verdadero hogar.


Cada episodio es una actualización matutina breve y fácil de escuchar (15 a 30 minutos, de lunes a viernes), diseñada para acompañarte mientras disfrutas tu café o te diriges al trabajo. Hablaremos de:

  • El pronóstico del tiempo local
  • Próximos eventos y lo más reciente de la comunidad
  • Noticias escolares, deportes, música, teatro y actividades
  • Actualizaciones de la policía, los bomberos y los servicios de emergencia
  • Lo más importante del Concejo Municipal y de la Junta Escolar
  • Eventos gratuitos organizados por negocios locales, iglesias y grupos comunitarios


Los lunes analizamos con más detalle lo que ocurrió en la comunidad durante el fin de semana, mientras que los viernes te ayudamos a planificar lo que viene: partidos, eventos, reuniones y actividades para disfrutar los próximos días.


Buenos Días Quincy WA no trata de los grandes titulares de las ciudades. Se trata de nuestros vecinos, nuestras escuelas y nuestra comunidad. Con un tono amigable, positivo y orgulloso de nuestras raíces, este programa es como esa conversación en el porche al comenzar cada día entre semana.

Ya seas residente de toda la vida o recién hayas llegado al área, toma tu café y comienza el día bien informado.


Si es importante en el 98848, ¡aquí lo escucharás!

Este programa se traduce del inglés al español mediante inteligencia artificial.

title: Story Of A Modern Woman
author: Ella Hepworth Dixon
description: This poignant short novel follows the journey of Mary Earl, a woman navigating the challenges of life in London at the close of the 19th century. As she strives to become a writer, Mary finds herself constrained by the rigid format expected of her work—one that confounds her creativity. Complicating her situation is her romance with a married man, adding to the emotional turmoil she faces. Celebrated as one of the finest examples of new woman literature, this story sheds light on the myriad struggles encountered by single women of the era, all conveyed through vivid prose that will resonate deeply with readers. - Summary by Stav Nisser

title: The Real Eddy Rivera Show
author: Eddy Rivera
description:
The Real Eddy Rivera Show builds strong foundations through real conversations, biblical truth, and authentic life experiences. We discuss faith, family, business, leadership, failure, and purpose, challenging people to grow spiritually, mentally, emotionally, and physically through a relationship with Jesus Christ. We don't just create content—we build people.
Real Talk. Real Faith. Real Life. Real Change.
Distributed by ATR Media LLC and The Real Eddy Rivera

title: The Meeked Horse Podcast
author: J8 Global
description: Welcome to The Meeked Horse Podcast: a space for dreamers, pioneering leaders, and disruptors – those brave enough to do life differently. MHP is hosted by Andy Williames, Doug McKinley, and Jonathan Gulley, business partners who in each episode confront the defining stories we've inherited while challenging us to lead from a place of meekness – power that can be trusted in any situation!

title: Inside The Colony
author: City of The Colony
description:
Inside The Colony is the official City podcast of the City of The Colony. Each episode features conversations with City leaders, department experts, elected officials and community partners discussing the projects, services and initiatives shaping our community. 
From public safety and infrastructure to economic development, special events and future planning, Inside The Colony offers a closer look at the work happening behind the scenes to keep The Colony thriving. 
Informative, engaging and community-focused, the podcast connects listeners with the people and stories driving a City forward.

title: SCREAMING: Horror Lives Here
author: Joshua Robert CEO of HOT AIR Network
description:
Welcome to SCREAMING, the horror podcast where we explore everything that goes bump in the night.

Hosted by Joshua Robert, SCREAMING is your monthly destination for the latest horror movie news, horror TV shows, movie reviews, spoiler discussions, ending explanations, trailers, first-look reactions, franchise updates, Stephen King adaptations, slasher films, supernatural horror, psychological thrillers, paranormal stories, haunted places, urban legends, creepy internet mysteries, true crime, and everything happening in the world of horror.


Every episode dives into the biggest horror headlines, breaks down the newest movies and television series, explores classic and modern horror franchises, and discusses the stories, filmmaking, practical effects, lore, and terrifying moments that horror fans can't stop talking about. From Scream, Friday the 13th, A Nightmare on Elm Street, Evil Dead, Halloween, The Conjuring, Terrifier, Final Destination, Carrie, Buffy the Vampire Slayer, and The Last of Us to independent horror films, hidden gems, haunted history, paranormal phenomena, and real-life mysteries, if it's creepy, cursed, possessed, haunted, or simply strange... we'll probably be talking about it.


Whether you're looking for your next scary movie, want the latest horror news, love deep dives into iconic franchises, enjoy spoiler-filled reviews, or just appreciate a fun conversation with someone who's just as obsessed with horror as you are, you've found your new favorite podcast.


New episodes drop monthly. Turn off the lights. Turn up the volume. Horror Lives Here.

title: Red Fence
author: Red Fence
description:
Welcome to Red Fence is where politics gets pulled apart—no talking points, no filters, no blind loyalty. Each episode dives into the stories shaping America and the world, cutting through media spin, government narratives, and the noise to ask the questions most people won’t.
From controversial headlines to underreported angles, Redfence challenges the official version and explores what’s really going on beneath the surface. Whether it’s policy, power, or hidden agendas, nothing is off-limits.
If you’re tired of being told what to think and want a sharper, more independent perspective, come on in.

title: Once Upon a Demigods Journey
author: Victoria Cervantes
description: Hii call me Vic/Vicky, i like the Percy Jackson series, the Inheritance games, and Once upon a Time. I post edits here, but feel free to give me recommendations on what to post. Here we support everyone and everything! Enjoy!

title: Relentless Restart
author: Gail DeMarco
description:
Nobody posts the part where it fell apart. We share the wins, the after photo, the comeback — almost never the middle, when you're starting from zero and not sure you've got it in you to go again. That middle is the whole show.

Relentless Restart is where people tell the story behind the story. Hosted by Gail DeMarco, every episode goes past the highlight reel to the real thing: the setback, the moment everything changed, and the decision to start over when walking away would have been easier.

These are honest, unfiltered conversations about resilience, redemption, and second chances, with people who have lived them. If you've ever had to begin again, or you're in the middle of it right now, this is for you.

New episodes released regularly. Follow the show so the next story finds you.

Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

title: Grief, Trauma & Your Mama
author: Angela Schellenberg
description:
Grief is trauma, because it is a break in attachment.

Angela Schellenberg is a grief and trauma therapist specializing in attachment, grief, and equine assisted learning. She lost both of her parents while she was still coming of age, and spent years believing she was broken before she understood what had actually happened to her.

This show is the manual she went looking for and could not find. Conversations about why grief lives in the body, how loss reshapes your identity, your self esteem and your sense of safety, and what it takes to feel safe again.

Attachment wounds are always healable. That is the whole reason this exists.

title: Deep Bible Stories
author: Deep Bible Stories
description:
Deep Bible Stories is where Christians come to go deeper into Scripture — book by book, chapter by chapter, line by line.

Every week we publish new teachings on the books of the Bible, the life of Christ, the prophets, the writings, and the truths most believers were never taught.

If you've been blessed here on YouTube and you'd like the full library — every course we've ever made plus every new lesson we release each week, ad-free, on every device — there's a quiet place for you to keep going:
👉 deepbiblestories.com/founding

title: Sports Love Affair: Incredible Stories
author: Willie Lee
description:
A Sports Love Affair: Incredible Stories takes you beyond the box scores, championships, and highlight reels to uncover the unforgettable journeys that have shaped the world of sports. Each episode explores the remarkable lives of athletes, coaches, teams, and moments that inspired generations through perseverance, sacrifice, courage, redemption, and triumph.

From unlikely underdogs and forgotten heroes to iconic games and history-changing moments, you’ll discover the human side of sports—the stories that remind us why we fell in love with the game in the first place.

title: Between The Verses
author: Daniel Moreau; Hannah Moreau
description: Between The Verses is a Bible exploration podcast hosted by Daniel & Hannah Moreau, where curiosity meets Scripture. Each episode dives into the history, culture, context, and deeper meaning behind God's Word. Together, we explore biblical mysteries, ask thought-provoking questions, and uncover the connections that bring Scripture to life. Whether you're new to the Bible or have studied it for years, join us as we discover what lies between the verses—one conversation at a time.

title: Before I Go Inside
author: Raven V
description: Hi, I’m Raven. This is the part of the day where I sit in my car a little longer than I need to. Sometimes I go down random rabbit holes. Sometimes I vent. Sometimes I overshare. Sometimes I solve absolutely nothing. If you’re looking for polished, this probably isn’t it. If you’re looking for honest, pull up a seat.

title: The African Possibility Podcast
author: Emmanuel Ogbaki
description:
The African Possibility Podcast explores the ideas, stories, and experiences shaping Africans across the diaspora and the continent. Through thoughtful conversations with leaders, thinkers, professionals, and creatives, the podcast highlights the possibilities, challenges, and opportunities facing Africans worldwide.
The African Possibility Podcast is a place where Africans can speak in their own words about their journeys, struggles, ideas, and hopes for the future.

title: Custom of the Country
author: Edith Wharton
description: Edith Whartons 1913 novel presents a sharp critique of American ambition and social climbing, following the relentless Undine Spragg on her quest for wealth and status. From the fictional Apex City in the Midwest to the bustling streets of New York and the glamour of Paris, Undines journey is marked by her determination to secure her place in high society, even if it means navigating the complexities of multiple marriages and divorces. - Summary by Elizabeth Klett

title: The CheckRare Brief
author: Peter Ciszewski, CheckRare
description:
A weekly roundup of the latest news in rare disease.

The CheckRare Brief delivers a concise roundup of the week's most important developments in rare diseases. Each episode covers FDA approvals, clinical trial updates, conference highlights, scientific publications, and industry news that matter to healthcare professionals, researchers, advocates, and the rare disease community.

Produced by CheckRare, The CheckRare Brief helps you stay informed—in just a few minutes each week.

I am a video game nerd from Dublin, Ireland with a love of nostalgia and all things gaming. Join me each week as I discuss my favourite video games. 
Created by Naoise O’Hare

author: Josh Griffin
description: Join Josh Griffin for the ride home after youth group in his soccer-mom 2018 Ford Flex! The drive home is 15-25 minutes - depending on how ugly the traffic is here in Southern California. Raw and uncut, thoughts, reaction, strategies, tips, tricks and more on the commute.

title: The Lone Ranger
author: The Lone Ranger
description: The Lone Ranger: In Pursuit of Justice Beneath the desert moon, the Lone Ranger and his faithful companion Tonto ride through the dunes on another epic journey. Out of the shadows and into the silence of the frontier, follow the story of the legendary masked hero who became the West's ultimate symbol of justice. Hit play and join the night ride

title: Education, Explained with John-Lloyd Williams
author: John-Lloyd Williams | JLW Education Consultancy
description:
Clear, practical conversations about the challenges shaping education today.
Created and curated by Headteacher and education consultant John-Lloyd Williams, the programme explores leadership, school improvement, curriculum, assessment, SEND, family advocacy and the modernisation of education.
Episodes use AI-generated presenters created through Google NotebookLM. Topics and source materials are selected and reviewed by John-Lloyd, with each discussion designed to turn complex educational issues into informed ideas and practical next steps.

title: The Long Way There
author: Sara and Brady Hand
description:
Welcome to The Long Way There, an infertility and IVF podcast for couples navigating the long road to parenthood.
Hosted by Sara and Brady, this show is about infertility, loss, faith, marriage, and what it really takes — as a couple — to build the family you’ve been believing for.
From male factor infertility and IVF to pregnancy after loss, embryo adoption, and NICU life, we share honest conversations and real storytelling for couples trying to find hope through the hardest parts of the journey.
Sometimes messy, always real. Let’s do it together.

title: Heck, Why Not?
author: Mark Valladares
description: Real conversations. Real stories. Real life. Join Mark Valladares as he explores life’s biggest questions, everyday decisions, personal growth, relationships, money, business, and the lessons we all learn along the way. Every episode is designed to help you think differently, live wiser, and remind you that sometimes the best decision begins with one simple question… Heck, Why Not?

title: Christianity After Deconstruction: Cabernet and Pray
author: Jeremy Jernigan, Christian Deconstruction Pastor
description:
Cabernet and Pray is a podcast for people who still have questions about Jesus but have complicated feelings about the church and Christianity. Hosted by Jeremy Jernigan (a recovering megachurch pastor), each episode pairs a glass of wine with honest conversations about the Bible, deconstruction, reconstruction, and what it means to explore faith outside of the boundaries of the theological mainstream. If you've ever felt like your doubts disqualified you, or you've wondered whether there's a version of Christianity that can hold your questions without flinching, then you've found your people.

This podcast is for you if you find yourself asking questions such as:
*How do I make sense of my faith with all of my doubts?
*Can I still follow Jesus if I have issues with the church?
*Do I have to choose between my questions and my faith?
*What do I do with the parts of the Bible that trouble me?
*Where do I go when the Christianity I inherited stops working?
*Am I allowed to read the Bible outside of the interpretations I grew up with?

title: Aesops Fables - new translation
author: Aesop
description: Discover the timeless wisdom of Aesop with this fresh translation of 284 captivating fables. Each story offers valuable lessons on a variety of subjects, showcasing the cleverness and insight that has made Aesop a beloved author for generations.

author: dalraidabaptistchurch
description: Listen to Sunday morning's sermon from Dalraida Baptist Church each week!

title: Witchcraft, Planchette, and Spiritualism Unveiled
author: Harriet Beecher Stowe, Samuel Robert Wells
description: In this captivating exploration, we revisit a time not so distant when ignorance and superstition led to the persecution and execution of countless individuals. This thought-provoking review sheds light on the progress weve made in moral, intellectual, and physical sciences since those dark days. By examining the evolution of Phrenology and Psychology, we reflect on the grim realities of the past—where entire cities fell victim to religious bigotry. Today, we are fortunate to live in an age illuminated by scientific understanding, which fosters broader liberality, religious tolerance, and individual freedom. As we delve into Anatomy, Physiology, and the Natural Sciences, we empower ourselves to seek knowledge and accountability, not from dogma but from truth itself. Join us on this enlightening journey through history as we uncover the lessons learned from our ancestors trials. (Summary by Samuel Robert Wells)

title: The School of Self Reinvention
author: Sandy Wade
description: School of Self Reinvention is the go-to podcast for people who desire to change.  From author and Master Life Coach, Sandy Wade, comes the ultimate podcast for anyone looking for inspiration to totally reinvent themselves and change their life. Featuring candid interviews with people who have done just that.  Success leaves clues.  People learn so much from others who have been there and have come out the other side. We all have a story to tell.  Listen to extraordinary stories from ordinary people.  Come, be inspired, perhaps find the courage to do a self-reinvention of your own.  New episodes premiere every Saturday.Visit sandywade.net to start your own self reinvention!

title: The Jesus and ADHD Podcast
author: Rachel Grit
description:
This podcast is for women who want to seek, find, and live the abundant life Jesus offers by cutting down the noise and chaos in their lives and their brains. This is a place where everyone is welcome, everyone has a seat at the table, and everyone is seen and heard.
We'll talk about scripture, ADHD, listening prayer, forgiveness, and so much more. Join me on this journey to abundant life! 🪴

title: Proverb Reflections
author: Matt Johnson Music
description: Listen daily to the ancient wisdoms found within the Proverbs of Solomon. Each episode features a 15-minute melding of Matt Johnson’s thoughtful narration and sensitive piano improvisations. Cycle through the entire book of Proverbs every month using this “musical audiobook” devotional tool. Those wishing to listen to the music alone…while creating their own personal time of reflection/meditation…will find the companion “Just the Music™ series” features each track without narration. • www.MattJohnsonMusic.com •

title: Humans of Salesforce: Who We Are
author: Salesforce
description:
From day one, Salesforce has believed business is a platform for change. We are the builders, the changemakers, and the AI-native learners rewriting the status quo.
Joy is our North Star, and our values are our guide. Our 80,000+ 'Ohana members are our ultimate competitive advantage, and this show is about the ones you haven't met—yet.
These are the humans of Salesforce... and this is who we are.

title: Horizon Deep Tech '25: The podcast
author: Finaman.io
description:
Building the future—one conversation at a time.

The BuildingBusiness Podcast explores the ideas, technologies and people shaping tomorrow's world.

Hosted by entrepreneur Christian Arnø, each episode features honest conversations with founders, investors, researchers and industry leaders building the next generation of businesses across AI, deep tech, quantum computing, robotics, defense, health tech, climate technology and entrepreneurship.

Rather than focusing on headlines, we dive into the stories behind the companies—the challenges, breakthroughs, failures and lessons that rarely make it onto stage.

title: Boy Talk
author: Boys’ Education Commission
description: Boys are toxic. Lacking aspiration. Corrupted by the manosphere. Lost. Confused. Failing their exams. Lacking motivation. But how much of this is true? Are boys and young men a problem to be fixed, or the source of huge untapped potential. Boy Talk aims to find out. It’s a series of honest conversations about the challenges facing boys and young men hosted by Peter Hyman, Chair of the Boys’ Education Commission, and former headteacher and political advisor. He talks to fascinating people on the challenges boys face and how we can help them to thrive. With insights, personal stories, controversial views and calls for action, these lively 30 minute discussions have one big aim - to start a debate on how we get all boys to thrive. Whether you are a parent, a teacher, a young person, a charity, an employer or a policy maker - join the conversation.

title: Seed Thoughts
author: Joseph Caryl
description: Dive into the remarkable world of Seed Thoughts, where the extensive work of Joseph Caryl unfolds before you. This monumental text, spanning two mighty folios and thousands of densely printed pages, is a testament to the dedication of its author, who spent half a lifetime meticulously crafting his insights on the Book of Job. Caryl, known for his preaching at the Honourable Society of Lincolns Inn and later at St. Magnus near London Bridge, invites readers to explore a treasure trove of profound reflections. Though the full work may be too vast to reproduce, within it lies a wealth of thought-provoking ideas, comforting words for the afflicted, and clear statements of gospel doctrine that promise to enrich the minds and hearts of all who engage with them. Join us in uncovering these valuable insights that have stood the test of time.

title: Second Apology of Justin Martyr
author: Saint Justin Martyr
description: In this powerful defense of the Christian faith, St. Justin Martyr presents a compelling argument to the Roman Senate in the second century AD, eloquently articulating the beliefs and values of early Christians. (Summary by IWYLLPA)

title: Seaboard Parish
author: George MacDonald
description: In the second installment of the captivating trilogy, we return to the familiar faces of the first book, now enriched with new friends and family. The Pastor relocates to a picturesque seaside parish, where he begins a new chapter in his preaching journey. With two beloved daughters, one of whom is struggling with her health, the family seeks the healing embrace of the ocean air. During their stay, they encounter a charming artist whose gentlemanly demeanor and vibrant spirit capture their hearts, especially that of one daughter. Together, they embark on a series of heartwarming adventures filled with laughter, love, and the challenges of life in the Parish. Experience the enchanting world of The Seaboard Parish as it unfolds alongside Annals of a Quiet Neighbourhood and The Vicars Daughter.

title: Scripture Characters
author: Robert Smith Candlish
description: Dive into nineteen captivating studies of biblical figures—some renowned and others lesser-known. Originally crafted as sermons, these discourses have been thoughtfully transformed into compelling narratives. Join us on this enlightening journey through the lives and lessons of these scriptural characters. - Summary by InTheDesert

title: School of Obedience
author: Andrew Murray
description: In School of Obedience, Andrew Murray delves into the vital importance and transformative power of complete obedience to God. He articulates not only the necessity of this obedience for all believers but also the pathways to achieve it, emphasizing that such a level of commitment is possible through divine provision. (Summary by Joy Chan)

title: Scholia on the Incarnation of the Only-Begotten

description: Dive into thirty-seven insightful articles that explore the profound question, What is Christ? Join us as we unpack the mystery of the Incarnation and its significance in our understanding of the divine.

title: Saved and Kept- or How to Get Saved and How to Keep Saved
author: G. A. McLaughlin
description: This concise volume is not meant to be a theological treatise or a comprehensive guide to the Christian life. Instead, the author aims to highlight the essential pathways through which sincere individuals can find salvation and maintain their faith. Written in straightforward, everyday language, this book is designed for those who seek clarity on the way to salvation. It is our hope that readers will find guidance and encouragement in their journey, ultimately leading them to a fulfilling relationship with God. With this purpose in mind, we present this work, praying it serves as a beacon for anyone eager to discover what God has in store for them.

title: Satan
author: Lewis Sperry Chafer
description: Discover the profound insights of a compelling Christian book that delves into the life and tactics of Satan. It reveals not only his motives but also the ultimate victory that every believer in Jesus Christ holds over him in todays world. Join Dawn Wallace as she summarizes this enlightening exploration of faith and resilience.

title: Saint Athanasius- The Father of Orthodoxy
author: Frances Alice Forbes
description: Dive into the life of Saint Athanasius, a remarkable figure whose unwavering courage and integrity shine through this unapologetic hagiography. With a straightforward narrative style, this biography portrays Athanasius as a beacon of brilliance, standing tall against the conniving villains of his time. For those familiar with the historical controversies, Athanasius emerges as a God-sent hero whose story is both informative and captivating. Experience an engaging introduction to a fascinating saint whose impact resonates through the ages. (Summary by Pattymarie)

Through its twelve thoughtfully organized chapters, the book articulates the profound importance of the Covenant of Grace, complete with its promises, conditions, and blessings. The Sacrifice of Praise serves as both a guiding light and a source of comfort for those looking to join the Church and for current members in full communion. We wholeheartedly commend this work to our congregations, particularly within the Reformed Church in America, as we believe that Dr. H. Bavinck stands as a remarkable figure among recent Reformed theologians, blessed by divine grace.

title: Calvins Expositions and Prayers on the Minor Prophets
author: John Calvin
description: While John Calvin is renowned for his profound theological writings, his heartfelt prayers often go unnoticed. This collection presents his extemporaneous commentaries on Jeremiah, Ezekiel, Daniel, and the minor prophets, originally delivered as lectures, each accompanied by thoughtful petitions. In his epistle to the King of Sweden, Calvin expressed a desire to limit the circulation of these informal teachings, meant specifically for the benefit of his audience. John Budaeus, in another preface, encourages readers to seek the guidance of the Holy Spirit in their Scripture reading. He highlights the value of the concise prayers included at the end of each lecture, which serve as examples for those who wish to articulate their own prayers through the words of Scripture. Calvins consistent prayer approach, combined with the spontaneous prayers inspired by the Spirit, offers a rich resource for spiritual growth.

Together we’ll examine what the Bible says about prayer, faith, overcoming life’s struggles, following Christ, and living a life that honors God.

Whether you’re a new Christian, a lifelong believer, or simply searching for biblical answers, you’ll find encouragement, practical lessons, and Christ-centered teaching rooted in the Scriptures.

As Jesus said:

“But you, when you pray, go into your room, and when you have shut your door, pray to your Father who is in the secret place; and your Father who sees in secret will reward you openly.”

title: What It's Really Like with Molly Burke
author: Molly Burke
description:
What It’s Really Like is a podcast hosted by Molly Burke, who draws on her lived experience as a blind woman to go beyond the superficial and uncover the unexpected stories behind fascinating lives. Each episode features honest, revealing conversations with people whose experiences challenge assumptions and change the way we see the world.

Prepare to drop the stereotypes, forget the taboo, and open your mind. It’s a show for thoughtful listeners who know every story is more complicated than it appears. For people who listen with empathy, think with openness, and always leave room to be surprised. Expect funny, intimate, and unpredictable stories that are impossible to pause. From pop-culture personalities and remarkable public figures to people who have lived through the unimaginable, every guest brings unexpected turns and unforgettable revelations.

Molly built her career by being raw and vulnerable, and she has seen the real-world impact that can have. Now, she is creating a space that empowers others to share with that same openness. Molly believes that when we understand one another better, we build compassion, bridge divides, and realize we have far more in common than we think. Raw, captivating, and deeply human, What It’s Really Like is for people who are more curious than certain—and who know the most fascinating stories begin when we make room for the awkward question.

Real conversations. Unfiltered truth. Faith that moves you to action.

Getting Real with Réal is where faith meets the battles of everyday life. Hosted by Réal Andrews — pastor, coach, athlete, cancer survivor, and recovered addict — this podcast tackles the conversations most people are afraid to have.

Whether you’re navigating financial tension, learning to trust God’s design for marriage, or simply desiring greater unity with your husband, this conversation offers biblical wisdom, practical encouragement, and the hope that God can redeem even the hardest seasons.

For years, she always felt so different, going through things no one could explain. Yet she learned how to live a meaningful life: going to school, playing competitive soccer through college, and staying connected to life by learning how to make intentional lifestyle choices.


Each episode shares empowering stories and science-backed tools to feel safe in your own body, build mental resilience, regulate your nervous system, navigate the healthcare system, advocate for yourself when you feel dismissed, and rediscover your purpose beyond your illness. Everybody's chasing the good life. Have you found yours? 

Abundant is a conversation about the life everyone's looking for — and what's getting in the way. Pastor Dan Jarvis, licensed family therapist Del Fehsenfeld, and other expert guests take on the quiet forces shaping and reshaping American culture. No panic, no partisanship, just honest conversation, ancient wisdom, and surprisingly ordinary ways to fight back.


Abundant is sponsored by Berrien.Life in Southwest Michigan. New episodes at abundant.show.

title: Bravery Trust - Real Stories | Real Impact
author: Bravery Trust
description: Real Stories, Real Impact with Garth Callender.

title: Adulting, Allegedly
author: Destiny Aina
description:
A talk show hosted by Destiny Aina, about navigating the beautiful, confusing, and sometimes overwhelming journey of becoming an adult.
From career changes and chasing dreams to relationships, money, identity, faith, and figuring out who you are along the way, this is a space for honest conversations about the things we’re all learning in real time.
Because let’s be honest… nobody really has adulthood completely figured out. We’re all just adapting, growing, making mistakes, celebrating wins, and pretending we know what we’re doing.
So, allegedly, we’re adults. But we’re still learning.

title: Down in the Bunker
author: James Merritt
description:
Down in the Bunker is an interview-style podcast hosted by James Merritt that explores the eDiscovery and legal technology industry through conversations with professionals working in the field. The series features candid discussions with:
Industry founders and consultants
Recruitment specialists
Legal technology professionals
eDiscovery practitioners
Each episode delves into guests' career journeys, their experiences in the eDiscovery sector, industry trends, and personal insights.

title: Head Office
author: Jacki Grace Coaching
description:
Talking business. Understanding brains.
Each week business coach Jacki Elsom helps business better understand their brains so they can stop losing time to indecision and mental noise.
Jacki helps you clear your mental clutter, make confident decisions, and build a business that gives you more say over where your time goes.

title: Center Stage Conversations
author: Juanita K. Hammons Hall for the Performing Arts
description: Center Stage Conversations is the official podcast of Juanita K. Hammons Hall for the Performing Arts in Springfield, Missouri. Go behind the curtain with the artists, producers, directors, and industry professionals who bring unforgettable live performances to our stage.

title: HER.
author: Brooke Redelle
description:
Welcome to HER podcast. 
A space dedicated to the women who are changing the world. 
Hosted by Brooke Redelle, HER (Heal | Empower | Recover) brings you intimate, honest conversations with powerful women in leadership. 
Together, we explore what it really takes to build an incredible life. Through shared stories and actionable wisdom, we discuss how we are healing our pasts, empowering one another to step into our potential, and how we found recovery. 
Join our community and discover how to lead with impact, resilience, and heart.

title: Beyond The Conclave
author: mikehpe
description:
Beyond the Conclave is a podcast dedicated to exploring the world, strategy, community, and ever-evolving battlefield of Malediction.

Whether you're opening your first faction box, building your next warband, preparing for a tournament, or diving deeper into the mysteries of the Malediction, this is your place to go beyond the tabletop.

Join us as we break down factions, units, cards, tactics, army building, new releases, tournament results, community events, lore, hobby projects, and everything happening across the growing world of Malediction. Expect strategy discussions, player interviews, community spotlights, tournament coverage, opinions, predictions, and probably a few bad dice rolls along the way.

Beyond the Conclave is built by players, for players—from those just discovering the game to veterans searching for their next competitive edge.

The Spheres are turning.

The battlefield is waiting.

It's time to go Beyond the Conclave.

A Malediction Podcast from the Deviant Dice Rollers community.

title: The Secret Life of Small Things
author: Jared Robinson and Dave Calvert
description:
What if the tiniest corners of your world were full of wonder, adventure, and hidden stories waiting to be discovered?
The Secret Life of Small Things is a heartwarming children’s podcast that invites kids, and the grown-ups who love them, into an adventurous world where little things come alive with imagination, wonder, and heart. 
From forgotten socks to noisy toy chests, each episode uncovers the magic, meaning, and imagination tucked into the smallest parts of life.
Because sometimes, the smallest things hold the biggest stories.

title: THE GLM PODCAST

description: The 2 Gen Z's you need to hear!🤗

A weekly podcast focusing on a different film in every episode.
Host and self-confessed film fanatic Rob Lopez-Lambert speaks at length with a guest about a new film every week.

author: TRC Media House
description:
Wyn TV brings you inside the world of mountain bike racing with pro rider Wyn Masters. 
Wyn interviews the best riders in the world in his own unique style before and after each World Cup downhill, enduro and cross country race. Wyn gets you closer to the riders, teams and personalities that make the sport what it is.
Produced and distributed by the TRC Media House.

title: Her Game
author: Golfmagic
description:
Her Game shines a spotlight on everything happening in women's golf. Join host Georgina Black as she holds weekly conversations with elite professionals and inspiring guests, plus in-person interviews at events. Her Game goes beyond just getting girls into golf, exploring the careers, opportunities, and possibilities that exist for women already in the game.


Her Game brings female role models across every corner of the sport including players, presenters, industry leaders and more — into the spotlight, celebrating how far women's golf has come while tackling the real challenges, that still need solving. Open to everyone who loves the game, this is a podcast for players, fans, and the friends and family cheering them on.

Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

description: Hi, I am Xandria and welcome to Let’s Talk About Ticks! This is a podcast where I talk about anything and everything tick related.

description: Welcome to Sword Art Online: The Audio Vault, where every dive holds a new adventure. From Aincrad and Alfheim to the Underworld and beyond, this is your home for fan-made Sword Art Online audio stories. Log in, gear up, and enjoy the journey.

title: Beyond
author: Brendan Mackenzie
description:
One minute the world was screaming. The next, it was dead air. There were no "out of service" icons, only a sudden vacuum where our lives used to be.
Beyond is not a story about the end of the world. It is a story about the walk back to what remains. It follows the slow and difficult journeys of survivors as they navigate a landscape stripped of its digital pulse.

title: The Adventures of Podge and Slim
author: Midnight Script
description: Welcome to the world's most questionable tavern: the Goblin Grub & Grog! Join Podge, an overly eager human with a pet rock, Slim, his grumpy half-hobbit best friend, Gordon the Goblin, a scheming boss with terrible ideas, Hilga, the terrifyingly competent assistant manager, and a cast of eccentric customers in the chaotic town of Taffleton. A comedy fantasy fiction podcast from Midnight Script, where every episode serves up laughs, ridiculous adventures and a healthy dose of chaos.

title: In Business with AI
author: Melbourne Business School
description:
In Business with AI is a podcast presented by Melbourne Business School that explores how artificial intelligence is reshaping business, leadership and the future of work. 
Hosted by Dean Jenny George, each episode features conversations with AI experts and CEOs who are implementing AI in unique ways in their organisations. 
We unpack what’s working, what’s not working, and how leaders can navigate one of the biggest technological transformations of our time.

title: SLPeace Podcast
author: Corina the SLP
description: A podcast dedicated to helping Speech Language Pathologists find peace while working a demanding career. The host, Corina Espejo, explores real challenges—burnout, imposter syndrome, poor work-life boundaries—that impact both professional fulfillment and personal well-being. Through personal lessons learned from pursuing peace as an SLP and candid conversations with other professionals, this podcast offers practical strategies for workplace resilience and sustainable joy for speech-language pathologists. Get real about everyday struggles, discover actionable solutions, and protect your peace. Fellow SLPs, welcome to the SLPeace Podcast— I hope you find and protect your personal and professional peace here.

description: The Joyous Edge Podcast helps purpose-driven, high-performing executives and leaders trade burnout and overcommitment for purpose, prioritization, and presence. Hosted by former KPMG Managing Director Joy St John, every episode is a masterclass in living fully, aligning your actions with your purpose, prioritizing your self-care, and becoming the confident, joy-filled executive you are meant to be.

title: The Matthew Chapman Podcast
author: Matthew Chapman
description: Join Matthew Chapman, a Cybersecurity Expert with over 30 years of experience architecting solutions for some of the world’s largest organizations. Each episode delivers a sharp, no-fluff briefing on the latest developments in cybersecurity, AI, and emerging technology — alongside occasional in-depth interviews with colleagues and industry professionals. Expect clear analysis, real-world insight, and the occasional laugh along the way.

title: Trauma Transformations with Dr. Rose
author: Dr. Rose Alkattan
description:
Trauma has a way of shaping the way we think, feel, and relate to God, ourselves, and others. But transformation is possible. Each week, Dr. Rose combines biblical truth, trauma psychology, neuroscience, and practical tools to help you break free from fear, anxiety, shame, people-pleasing, limiting beliefs, and the emotional patterns that keep you stuck.


Welcome to Trauma Transformations with Dr. Rose, the podcast where faith and psychology come together to help you heal from the wounds of your past, renew your mind, and walk confidently in your God-given purpose.


Whether you’re healing from childhood trauma, relationship wounds, betrayal, grief, or simply feeling called to something greater, you’ll learn how to renew your mind, regulate your emotions, strengthen your faith, and build the life God created you to live.


Each episode will leave you with practical strategies you can apply immediately, biblical encouragement to strengthen your faith, and the hope that transformation is possible.


It’s time to stop merely surviving and start living with purpose.


We Got This!

title: NonStop Local Nightly Podcast
author: NonStop Local
description: NonStop Local Nightly with Bradley Warren is produced by KHQ and delivering the day's top stories from Spokane and Coeur d'Alene, plus exclusive reporting and deeper conversations on the biggest issues affecting the Inland Northwest. From breaking news and wildfire coverage to crime investigations, local politics, severe weather, and community impact, you'll get the context behind the headlines every weeknight.

title: Dylan Graves: Dark and Twisted

title: First Class Leaders Podcast
author: kyle856
description:
Leadership isn't a title, a rank or a position. It's a choice. 

This podcast about what leadership actually looks like when the pressure is on, hosted by Kyle Freiburger, a former Air Canada Airbus 320 captain with over 10,000 hours in the cockpit.

Every week Kyle sits down with pilots, aviation professionals and leaders from outside the industry to talk about the part most people skip. Not the highlight reel, but what they struggled with, what they got wrong and how choosing to take the lead changed the way they show up.

You'll hear honest conversations about reacting out of fear instead of leading with intention, about the gap between what we intend and the impact we actually have and about the daily choices that separate people who wait for permission from people who take responsibility for how they show up.

No gurus and no formulas for a perfect career. Just real stories, practical tools and a simple question worth asking on your worst day. How can I take the lead right now?

New episodes weekly. Are you ready to take the lead?

title: Secret Tapes
author: Matthew Rao and Roman Buetel
description:
The show's called Secret Tapes. It's filled with silly stories.
---
Created by Matthew Rao & Roman Buetel, Secret Tapes is a short story comedy podcast featuring a rotating cast of neurotic fools. Join us each month for a new episode. Tell your friends!

title: Mind of a Geek
author: Rollin House Productions
description:
Mind of a Geek is where the people behind geek culture tell their stories.


Every episode, hosts Nate and Brandon sit down with creators, artists, developers, authors, cosplayers, streamers, podcasters, convention organizers, and other passionate members of the geek community to explore the journeys that brought them here. We start with the guest, but the conversation rarely stays on script. Before long, we're diving into the games we love, the stories that shaped us, the conventions we've survived, the projects we're building, and the wonderfully chaotic world of being a geek.


Whether you're interested in tabletop gaming, video games, comics, fantasy, science fiction, cosplay, filmmaking, technology, or the creative process itself, Mind of a Geek is a place for genuine conversations instead of rehearsed interviews. Every guest has a unique perspective, and every episode is an opportunity to discover the people helping shape the communities we call home.

Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

The Filing Room is a show about regulatory compliance in payments and crypto.

Hosted by Pamela, it brings practical experience from real work.

description: A quest to find the best and worst whiskies ever made. Two fellas and two bottles per episode. One list to rule them all. Drink along with John and Chris as they sort the shelf one sip at a time.

title: Benched
author: Pride Cup
description:
Sport is weird. We should probably talk about that.


Hosted by Rudy Jean Rigg, Hannah Wilkinson and Mitch Brown, Benched is a sports and culture podcast unpacking the biggest moments in sport, from the stories everyone is talking about to the ones nobody is paying attention to.


We dive into the conversations happening beyond the scoreboard: the culture, internet drama, politics, identity, fandoms and ridiculous moments that make sport so much more than a game.


Expect sports news, athlete interviews, hot takes, internet rabbit holes, pop culture tangents and the stories traditional sports media misses. Benched brings a queer perspective to the biggest conversations in sport, without taking the fun out of it.

Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

title: Respectfully Speaking
author: BK Irons
description:
Welcome to Respectfully Speaking, the podcast where real conversations happen with no filter, no fake deep moments, and no sugarcoating. From relationships, culture, sports, and trending topics to comedy, life lessons, and everyday chaos, nothing is off limits. Expect raw opinions, hilarious stories, heated debates, and perspectives that’ll have you laughing one minute and thinking the next.


Hosted with authenticity, humor, and a little bit of petty energy, this is the spot where grown conversations meet real life. Pull up, tap in, and join the discussion… respectfully.

title: The Pop Culture Pantry

description: Welcome to the Pop Culture Pantry! Join us as we take little deep dives across the decades and discover the exciting connections between food, history, and pop culture trends. We’ll talk about celebrity cookbooks, TV tie-ins, forgotten brand names, community collections and everything in between! And along the way, we’ll uncover the stories behind the recipes and the cultural moments that inspired them.

title: Don't Lose
author: Karen Thrall
description: Each week, author and executive coach Karen Thrall dives into one human tension that shapes how we live, lead, and connect. Through stories and conversations, discover how to hold onto your curiosity, your courage, your humanity, and your sense of purpose. Become more of who you are, not less.

title: Few for the Many

description: Few for the Many features story-driven conversations with individuals whose lives have been shaped through cross-cultural encounters and relationships. It is a space to listen, learn, and be encouraged by lived experience in global communities.

description: In the aftermath of three devastating fires that destroyed hundreds of properties and left thousands displaced in Spokane, reporters and editors from The Spokesman-Review sit down with members of the community to not just talk about the impact, but the way forward.

description: Telling 100+ Years of Stories -- One Voice at a Time

title: Life After 30: Unfiltered
author: The Vibe is Grown
description: Life After 30: Unfiltered is a candid conversation about rebuilding, rediscovering, and redefining life after 30. From career pivots and personal growth to faith, finances, friendships, confidence, and starting over, no topic is off limits. This isn’t about having it all figured out—it’s about navigating adulthood with honesty, humor, and purpose. Join for real conversations, life lessons, and the kind of advice you’d share with a friend over coffee.

title: Solo Parenting Confessions
author: The Vibe Is Grown
description:
Unfiltered. Unapologetic. Unmatched.
This isn’t the highlight reel — this is the truth behind solo parenting.
Hosted by a real-life solo mom navigating motherhood without backup, Solo Parenting 
Confessions brings you weekly episodes filled with raw honesty, laughter, and everything in between. From late night mental breakdowns to breakthrough moments, we talk dating, mom, guilt, ambition, family drama, and the stuff you wish more people were real about.
If you’ve ever felt alone, tired, or just needed to hear “same,” this is the space for you.

title: The Chancla Collective

description: 🩴☕❤️ The podcast for overstimulated humans trying their best. Messy meets meaningful. Mental health, motherhood, firewife life, friendships, grief, healing, and the chaos of adulting…without pretending we have it all figured out. Hosted by Alexis Fernandez and friends.

title: The Hair Edit with Ateh Jewel & Victoria Lynch
author: atehjewel
description: Welcome to The Hair Edit hosted by Ateh Jewel & Victoria Lynch an exciting new podcast bringing together the UK's most respected voices across hair, beauty, health and entrepreneurship exploring conversations women have everyday but are often overlooked such as ageing, postpartum hair loss, comfidence, GLP- 1s and professional hair care. Expect expert insights, honest open discussion which will educate, entertain and empower.

title: Firelight: A CONSTELLATION Podcast
author: Elizabeth Johnson
description: Firelight is a podcast from CONSTELLATION - a coalition of cancer care and resource coordination organizations - exploring the experiences and ideas shaping more human-centered healthcare. Patients, caregivers, professionals, researchers, designers, and community leaders share honest conversations about navigating care, building trust, and improving access. Like stories shared around a fire beneath the stars, each episode offers warmth, connection, and practical insight for the journey ahead.

title: The Full Hookup
author: CrappyRV
description: The Full Hookup is the CrappyRV podcast — real RV talk, real stories, no bull. Hosted by David, a full-time RVer who's owned four rigs and survived 135+ defects, breaking down the RV world the way it actually is: recalls, industry stats, dealer games, warranty fights, and your worst rig stories. Independent, unsponsored, owner-operated — never paid by a manufacturer. New episodes when it matters. Got a lemon story? Send it in and it might get read on air. Good luck out there.

title: Great Commission Podcast
author: Apostolics WorldWide
description: Hearing from the church globally.

title: The Fresh Hour
author: Cameron and Emily Freshour
description:
Welcome to The Fresh Hour Podcast! We are Cameron and Emily Freshour, a husband-and-wife team sharing our passion for hunting, the outdoors, and everything in between. 
From chasing big bucks and spring gobblers, to behind-the-scenes stories, we’ll bring you real conversations, unforgettable experiences and hunting strategies we live by every season! We will also be giving you a glimpse of our success stories and mistakes we have learned by. We are no experts, but want to share how we strive to be better hunters every day! So grab a cup of coffee, settle in, and spend the next hour with us!

author: Lupie Lotus

Cosplay With Me is an initiative to reform the literacy rate of America by way of creativity and the performance arts.

The Houston Chronicle's biggest stories in audio form every weekday morning. Stay connected to the city in 10 minutes or less.


Every episode includes a brief forecast by meteorologist Justin Ballard and is produced and edited by human editors using stories written by human journalists. It is read using text-to-speech technology.

title: The Sports and Friendship show
author: Jack
description:
Good Sports. Better Friends.

Longtime friends. Now spread across the country. One great conversation.

Sports and Friendship is a weekly sports podcast where the conversations are just as important as the games. We cover the biggest stories in college football, the NFL, MLB, NHL, golf, and more while making weekly game picks, season-long predictions, and debating the topics every sports fan is talking about.

But sports are only part of the story.

We’ve been friends for years, and every episode feels like pulling up a chair in the man cave to catch up. Along the way you’ll hear stories from our days as teammates, road trips, hunting camps, golf rounds, and the kind of conversations that only happen between lifelong friends.

Whether you’re here for the sports, the laughs, or the stories, we’re glad you’re here.

title: Beyond the Signs

description: Welcome to Howie’s Hot Takes!

title: Your Life Systems
author: Wes Young
description:
Your Life Systems is a podcast about building practical systems for everyday life.

Join Wes as he shares simple ideas, practical frameworks, and real-world experience to help you make consistent progress in the areas of life that matter most.

Most people don't need more information. They need better implementation.

Instead of relying on motivation, you'll learn how to build systems that make success easier, more consistent, and more sustainable.

title: MAMA - Motherhood. Alcohol. Mental Health. Anxiety
author: Victoria Vanstone
description:
MAMA: Motherhood. Alcohol. Mental Health. Anxiety.


Hosted by Victoria Vanstone, author, speaker and co-host of the award-winning podcast Sober Awkward, MAMA is an honest, funny and reassuring podcast about the realities of modern motherhood.


From anxiety and overwhelm to wine o’clock culture, identity, relationships and mental health, Victoria explores the conversations many mums are thinking about but rarely say out loud.


Created in association with Healthy Mum Healthy Bub, researchers from The University of Sydney, and funded by the Medical Research Future Fund, MAMA combines lived experience, expert knowledge and practical tools to support mums through the challenges of parenting, mental health and alcohol use.


Drawing on both research and real-life experience, each episode tackles topics such as anxiety, stress, self-compassion, emotional wellbeing, motherhood, and the role alcohol can play in our lives. Through honest conversations, personal stories, humour and evidence-based insights, MAMA aims to help women feel informed, supported and less alone.


If you’re feeling overwhelmed, struggling with anxiety, questioning your relationship with alcohol, or simply wondering why everyone else seems to have motherhood figured out, you’re in the right place.


Real conversations. Expert insights. No judgement. Just practical support, a few laughs, and a reminder that you’re not doing this alone.

Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

Each episode delivers a concise roundup of the day's biggest headlines, local news, sports, current events, and the conversations shaping the region—keeping listeners informed, engaged, and connected to what's happening close to home.

Each episode is hosted by members of the Foundation and features conversations with local donors, grant recipients, board members, and community leaders who are making a lasting impact throughout Tipp City. Learn how charitable giving supports meaningful projects, hear the stories behind recent grants, meet the people guiding the Foundation's mission, and stay up to date on upcoming events and initiatives.  Whether you're a longtime supporter, a curious resident, or someone looking to get more involved, So Far So Good offers an inside look at how generosity continues to shape the future of Tipp City, one conversation at a time.

description:
Step back to the sun-soaked hills of 1960s and 70s Los Angeles, where a quiet neighbourhood became the birthplace of some of the most influential music ever written.

Each episode of Laurel Canyon, Mark Allbrook explores the artists, albums and stories that defined an era. From the harmonies of folk-rock to the rise of country rock, discover the music, friendships, rivalries and inspiration that flowed through this legendary creative community.

Expect classic tracks, fascinating background stories and the cultural moments that shaped the soundtrack of a generation.

Whether you're a lifelong fan or discovering these timeless songs for the first time, Laurel Canyon is your invitation to revisit one of music's most remarkable chapters.

Welcome to It's The Man School — Dating Mastery for the Modern Man

Hosted by 3 expert women, from 3 generations, with 3 different perspectives and 1 shared passionate vision: coaching men to master modern dating and to become the kind of partner women are excited to choose.

author: Arnel
description:

description:
For four years, nobody in Portland died by violence on a public street. Then, in a single week, five people do. A software engineer waiting for a ride. A pharmacy tech on the Fremont Bridge. A retired advisor in a parking garage. A man carrying groceries in from the curb. A kindergarten teacher, sixty-eight years old, waiting in her own driveway.

title: Some Things Considered's Podcast
author: Some Things Considered
description:
Thanks for stopping by. As the title suggests, Some Things Considered will consider, well, some things. For one thing, we have a limited budget—in fact, we have no budget—and we simply don’t have the resources to consider all things like the crew at NPR.

As people might guess, Some Things Considered has no affiliation with NPR. It does not subscribe to their worldview, nor do we adhere to their monotony (vocally speaking). We are a discussion among friends, a conversation around the dinner table.  

Perhaps you are wondering—like we are—why people over the last few years have become so damn mean or why we must conform for conformity’s sake. Other questions we are considering are what has become of America, the dream of the world we grew up in. Yet other considerations are what happened to education, the arts, science, sports and entertainment, journalism—or sanity, for that matter.  

Tune in bi-weekly as we probe these and other topics, as well as have a few laughs.

Chaos to Calm with Sami Ward is a supportive podcast for mums and parents navigating the emotional storms of young adults struggling with emotional dysregulation, BPD/EUPD, anxiety, self-harm, suicidal thoughts, and complex mental health challenges.

If you feel exhausted, overwhelmed, constantly firefighting crises, or like nobody truly understands what life is like behind closed doors… you are not alone.

⚓ understand emotional dysregulation
⚓ communicate more calmly during conflict

description:
Chronic Pain Reprocessing - Rewire, Renew, Reclaim: The Podcast
Based on the book ’Chronic Pain Reprocessing - A Step-by-Step Guide to Understanding & Overcoming Neuroplastic Pain’, this podcast is for anyone living with long-standing pain that hasn’t been resolved or fully explained — and who’s been left feeling stuck in limbo without a clear diagnosis or a clear way forward.
The podcast is based on the work and research of Osteopath and Pain Reprocessing Therapist, Simon Chafer, who has spent over 20 years treating musculoskeletal pain and holds a master’s degree in pain management from Cardiff University School of Medicine. Each episode unpacks how chronic pain really works — and why it can persist long after any original tissue damage has healed. Drawing on the biopsychosocial model of pain, Simon explores the physical, psychological, and social drivers that keep pain going, from fear-avoidance and catastrophising to the nervous system’s role as an ”alarm system” that can get stuck switched on.
Episodes cover practical, evidence-based approaches — including somatic tracking, mindfulness, breathing and body-awareness techniques, and the role of therapies such as EFT or tapping therapy — all aimed at helping you shift from feeling helpless about your pain to actively managing it.
This isn’t about quick fixes. It’s about understanding your pain, identifying what’s driving it, and building a holistic, sustainable path toward taking back control.
New episodes every week (clinical work permitting!)
